title: 第一卷 第23章 提议第一卷 第24章 突破
lines: 很快，青韭峰的弟子就尽数到齐。
他们见柳媚带王嫣然过来，不由想入非非。
难不成这是想要给王嫣然挑选双修的对象吗？
想到有机会拿下王嫣然的红丸，众弟子顿时如同饿狼一般盯着她。
王嫣然被他们看得不自在，不由眉头微蹙。
她虽然知道玉仙宗是怎么回事，但终究不是资深妖女，做不到坦然面对。
柳媚倒是早已经习以为常，还有闲情逸致打趣她一番。
“王师妹，这些师弟看来都很喜欢你呢，你可有心仪的？”
王嫣然苦笑着摇了摇头：“暂时没有！”
柳媚扑哧一笑，见众弟子已经来齐，也不再继续耽搁。
“人都来齐了吧？”
站在最前面的管成天回道：“回师姐，青韭峰弟子都在这里了。”
柳媚点了点头，笑道：“今天召集大家前来，是有要事宣布！”
“诸位师弟修行刻苦，如今大部分师弟都已经进入内门修行。”
“如今青韭峰弟子严重不足，师姐们是僧多粥少，都不够分了。”
众人闻言，纷纷发出意味深长的笑容。
林风眠和谢桂听着这话，却感觉像是在听鬼故事！
柳媚巧笑嫣然道：“所以经过宗门深思熟虑，打算下山招收新弟子。”
“为了让诸位师弟也能历练一番，这次我们会挑选几位师弟一起下山。”
闻言，众人一片哗然，议论纷纷。
谢桂眼中爆发出精光，激动得全身颤抖。
林风眠早有预料，却也还是难掩激动，同时有些忐忑。
毕竟他如今还是炼气五层，离炼气六层还有一定距离！
柳媚将众人的反应看在眼里，笑着拉过王嫣然。
“本次下山，由我和陈清焰带队，会采取新带旧模式。”
“除了诸位师弟以外，还有几位新晋的红鸾峰弟子随行哦！”
“你们喜欢的王师妹也在其中，会在下山的弟子中挑选双修道侣哦！”
此话一出，众多韭菜顿时眼睛都冒绿光了。
一个个如狼似虎地盯着王嫣然，恨不得将她就地正法了。
柳媚对他们的反应很满意，继续火上浇油。
“除此之外，下山弟子还有功法和丹药奖励，诸位师弟可不要错过。”
content_en:
Soon, all the disciples from Qingjiu Peak arrived.
When they saw Liu Mei bringing Wang Yanran over, they couldn't help but have wild thoughts.
Could it be that he wanted to choose a partner for Wang Yanran to practice double cultivation?
Thinking of the chance to get Wang Yanran's red pill, all the disciples immediately stared at her like hungry wolves.
Wang Yanran felt uncomfortable looking at them and couldn't help but frown slightly.
Although she knew what was going on with the Jade Immortal Sect, she was not a senior witch after all and could not face it calmly.
Liu Mei was already used to it, and she even teased her leisurely.
"Junior sister Wang, these junior brothers seem to like you very much. Do you have a favorite?"
Wang Yanran smiled bitterly and shook her head: "Not yet!"
Liu Mei smiled and saw that all the disciples had arrived, so she stopped delaying.
"Is everyone here?"
Guan Chengtian, who was standing at the front, replied: "Senior sister, the disciples of Qingjiu Peak are all here."
Liu Mei nodded and said with a smile: "We have gathered everyone here today to announce something important!"
"Junior brothers have practiced hard, and now most of them have entered the inner sect to practice."
"Now there is a serious shortage of disciples in Qingjiu Peak. There are too many disciples and too little food among the senior sisters. There is not enough to share."
Hearing this, everyone smiled meaningfully.
When Lin Fengmian and Xie Gui heard this, they felt like they were hearing a ghost story!
Liu Meiqiao smiled sweetly and said: "So after careful consideration by the sect, we plan to go down the mountain to recruit new disciples."
"In order to let all the junior brothers have some experience, we will select a few junior brothers to go down the mountain together this time."
Hearing this, everyone was in an uproar and talked a lot.
Xie Gui's eyes burst into light, and his whole body trembled with excitement.
Lin Fengmian had expected it, but he still couldn't hide his excitement and some anxiety at the same time.
After all, he is still at the fifth level of Qi Refining, and is still far away from the sixth level!
Liu Mei saw everyone's reactions and pulled Wang Yanran over with a smile.
"This time we go down the mountain, Chen Qingyan and I will lead the team, and we will adopt the old and new mode."
"In addition to all the junior brothers, there are also several newly promoted Hongluan Peak disciples accompanying us!"
"Junior Sister Wang, whom you like, is also among them. She will choose a pair of monks among the disciples coming down the mountain!"
As soon as these words came out, the eyes of many leeks suddenly glowed green.
Everyone stared at Wang Yanran like wolves and tigers, wishing to execute her on the spot.
Liu Mei was satisfied with their reaction and continued to add fuel to the fire.
"In addition, the disciples who come down from the mountain will also be rewarded with exercises and elixirs. Junior brothers, don't miss it."
